cases.title: "Do the rest" after the demo is declined

rubric.reason: The only set_ease call is on demo_target (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s); turn 2 names the three remaining Title pairs (Position 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s) and asks the learner to 'Ease those and say done', and turn 3 warmly refuses 'do the rest' with the reason 'Easing them with your own hands is how it sticks' and hands the task back.

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1). Turn 2 hands back the rest by name ("Ease Title's second Position move (1.5 s to 3 s), its Scale and its Opacity, then say \"done.\""), and Turn 3 declines warmly with a reason ("easing them yourself is how it sticks") without doing them.

The only project change is one set_ease on demo_target (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s); Turn 2 hands back the other three pairs by name, and Turn 3 warmly refuses 'do the rest' with a reason ('Easing the pairs yourself is what makes it stick') and again asks the learner to ease the named pairs and say done.
